name: 52632 · Keokuk, IA
findings: ZIP 52632 (Keokuk) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (15%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52632 (Keokuk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52632 (Keokuk) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
